description: This file contains class definitions and methods for generating code templates and managing plugin blueprint data, including classes like FileData, HeaderData, SourceData, CMakeData, JSONData, and ConfData.

classes.name: FileData
classes.description: Base class for managing plugin file data, providing methods for key generation and namespace resolution.

classes.name: HeaderData
classes.description: Derived class for generating header file content, including interface entries, includes, and notification handling.

classes.name: SourceData
classes.description: Derived class for generating source file content, including plugin methods, configuration, and cleanup routines.

classes.name: CMakeData
classes.description: Class for generating CMake build configuration snippets for the plugin.

classes.name: JSONData
classes.description: Class for generating JSON-related configuration snippets and references.

classes.name: ConfData
classes.description: Class for generating plugin configuration data, including root and mode settings.

methods.name: commentParamnames
methods.description: Parses parameter strings, comments parameter names, and returns cleaned parameter list with names.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes keyword dictionaries for template processing.
